objective: Produce a competitor and alternatives map for field-service scheduling tools used by Indian SMEs with 5-50 technicians, so the product lead can decide the positioning wedge.
context: Discovery stage of workflow idea-to-business. Informs decision D-002 (segment choice). Hypothesis H-004 says incumbents under-serve WhatsApp-first dispatch; this task must try to disconfirm it.
constraints: Cite URL and access date for every competitor fact.
Include manual and spreadsheet workarounds as alternatives.
Do not estimate competitor revenue without a disclosed source.
acceptance_criteria: At least 6 direct competitors and 3 substitutes are listed with segment, pricing (or 'not public'), distribution and switching cost.
Every row has a dated source in the evidence ledger.
The map names at least one positioning gap and at least one piece of evidence against H-004.
No unsourced market-size or revenue figures appear.
verification: research-auditor opens three random ledger URLs, checks dates, and confirms the disconfirming-evidence section exists.
